waves.name: Read-only master readers
waves.rationale: Three small programs and their jobs read the card, cross reference and customer masters and write nothing that another program reads. They prove the toolchain, the fixed-width record codecs, the EBCDIC handling, and the first harness run against the same files the refresh jobs rebuild.
waves.unblocks: The shared record codec for CVACT02Y, CVACT03Y and CVCUS01Y, the equivalence harness every later wave reuses, and the read-back check the master refresh needs.

waves.name: Hard-pattern batch utilities
waves.rationale: The first signed money fields in display form (account balances), the first packed decimal fields, the OCCURS DEPENDING ON variable-length output, the assembler date call and the REDEFINES multi-record export all sit here. They read the masters and write only scratch or export datasets, so the hard patterns are learned where a mistake cannot reach a master.
waves.unblocks: Signed decimal money, packed decimal, variable-length and REDEFINES handling that CBTRN03C, CBSTM03A and the money core reuse, and the branch migration feed.

waves.name: Administration front door
waves.rationale: Sign-on, both menus, user maintenance, transaction type maintenance on Db2 and the reference data chain that feeds the report. The three front door programs are one strongly connected component. The user file and the Db2 table each have writers only inside this wave, so both stores can move without a coexistence problem. A high-high unit, job:TRANEXTR, sits in this wave. It stays with its Db2 table because a datastore moves with its writers.
waves.unblocks: The menu tables that let each online option in waves 4 and 6 flip on its own, the date validation service CSUTLDTC that three later programs call, and the type and category files the transaction report reads.

waves.name: Read-only inquiry and the transaction report
waves.rationale: Every program here reads the masters and writes none. The transaction report, batch and online, is one of the three things the client named. Three units are high-high (CBTRN03C, CORPT00C, job:TRANREPT). They sit at the halfway point because the report is read-only, rerunnable, and can be run in parallel with the legacy job on a copy of the same inputs. Hold this wave until the harness from waves 1 to 3 is proven.
waves.unblocks: Retires legacy read access to the masters, which leaves only the writers in wave 6, and moves the online report launcher off the internal reader queue.

waves.name: Account statements
waves.rationale: Read-only over four masters, with output files that no program in the tree reads. The program uses ALTER, GO TO and direct control block walking, so it is rewritten from what it does, not ported. Statements were not named by the client, so the score is provisional.
waves.unblocks: Retires the assembler and control block dependent code path and the TXT2PDF converter.

waves.name: Money core: posting, interest, balances, master refresh and batch order
waves.rationale: Every writer of the account, transaction, customer, card and category balance masters, the jobs that delete and reload those masters, the batch window jobs and every scheduler entry. Daily posting and the master refresh, two of the three things the client named, are here. The writers cut over at one switch behind an account and transaction access facade, and the plan orders the cut over inside the wave. It is last but for the optional modules, and it is strangled, not ported.
waves.unblocks: Retirement of VSAM as the system of record, of the console-driven CLOSEFIL and OPENFIL protocol, and of the three conflicting schedulers.

waves.name: IMS and MQ authorization and MQ services
waves.rationale: Optional modules with their own resource definitions and stores: an IMS authorization database, an MQ authorization decision program and two MQ request and reply services. The extractor does not model IMS or MQ, and one program in it, COPAUA0C, decides authorizations in real time. Whether this wave belongs in the project is a scope decision for the client, so it comes last with low confidence.
waves.unblocks: Retirement of the IMS and MQ runtime dependencies.
